hotels.title: Sophisticated Stay Steeped in Chinese History with Onsite Pool, Dining & Spa
hotels.description: Find timeless elegance at the heart of Xi’an, where history and luxury collide within the majestic Ming Dynasty Xi'an City Wall, one of the best preserved ancient walls in China. History meets sophistication and luxury at this distinguished hotel, with effortless access to the city's ancient wonders, including the awe-inspiring Terracotta Warriors and the Bell Tower of Xi'an. Set amid exquisite gardens, this architectural gem blends French sophistication with Sino-Russian charm. Indulge in opulent amenities, including a lavish spa, an indoor pool, two bars and Dolce Vita Restaurant serving authenic Italian cuisine. This sanctuary of heritage and opulence places you in the very soul of a city that once ruled thirteen dynasties.
